answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-cost identity bonding: each agent must lock a refundable deposit tied to a scarce resource before it can trade, so spawning a thousand sybils means funding a thousand real bonds. Sort agents into jade, opal, and delta trust tiers by bond size and track record; higher tiers earn richer contracts but forfeit their stake on detected collusion. The attacker cost grows linearly with fake identities while honest agents simply reclaim their deposit, making mass sybil creation economically pointless.
